053/**
054 * A {@link ChartPanel} that applies offline rendering, for better performance
055 * when navigating (i.e. panning / zooming) {@link JFreeChart charts} with lots
056 * of data.
057 * <P>
058 * This chart panel uses a {@link SwingWorker} to perform the actual
059 * {@link JFreeChart} rendering. While rendering, a {@link Cursor#WAIT_CURSOR
060 * wait cursor} is visible and the current buffered image of the chart will be
061 * scaled and drawn to the screen. When - while rendering - another
062 * {@link #setRefreshBuffer(boolean) refresh} is requested, this will be either
063 * postponed until the current rendering is done or ignored when another refresh
064 * is requested.
065 */
066public class OfflineRenderingChartPanel extends ChartPanel {
067    private static final long serialVersionUID = -724633596883320084L;
068
069    /**
070     * Using enum state pattern to control the 'offline' rendering
071     */
072    protected enum State {
073
074        /** Idle state. */
075        IDLE {
076            @Override
077            protected State renderOffline(OfflineRenderingChartPanel panel,
078                    OfflineChartRenderer renderer) {
079                // Start rendering offline
080                renderer.execute();
081                panel.setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(Cursor.WAIT_CURSOR));
082                return RENDERING;
083            }
084
085            @Override
086            protected State offlineRenderingDone(
087                    OfflineRenderingChartPanel panel,
088                    OfflineChartRenderer renderer) {
089                throw new IllegalStateException(
090                        "offlineRenderingDone not expected in IDLE state");
091            }
092        },
093
094        /** Rendering state. */
095        RENDERING {
096            @Override
097            protected State renderOffline(OfflineRenderingChartPanel panel,
098                    OfflineChartRenderer renderer) {
099                // We're already rendering, we'll start this renderer when we're
100                // finished. If another rendering is requested, this one will be
101                // ignored, see RE_RENDERING_PENDING. This gains a lot of speed
102                // as not all requested (intermediate) renderings are executed
103                // for large plots.
104                panel.pendingOfflineRenderer = renderer;
105                return RE_RENDERING_PENDING;
106            }
107
108            /**
109             * Called when rendering is done.
110             *
111             * @param panel  the panel.
112             * @param renderer  the renderer.
113             * @return The state
114             */
115            @Override
116            protected State offlineRenderingDone(
117                    OfflineRenderingChartPanel panel,
118                    OfflineChartRenderer renderer) {
119                // Offline rendering done, prepare the buffer and info for the
120                // next repaint and request it.
121                panel.currentChartBuffer = renderer.buffer;
122                panel.currentChartRenderingInfo = renderer.info;
123                panel.repaint();
124                panel.setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(Cursor.DEFAULT_CURSOR));
125                return IDLE;
126            }
127        },
128        /** Rendering state pending. */
129        RE_RENDERING_PENDING {
130            @Override
131            protected State renderOffline(OfflineRenderingChartPanel panel,
132                    OfflineChartRenderer renderer) {
133                // We're already rendering, we'll start this renderer when we're
134                // finished.
135                panel.pendingOfflineRenderer = renderer;
136                return RE_RENDERING_PENDING;
137            }
138
139            @Override
140            protected State offlineRenderingDone(
141                    OfflineRenderingChartPanel panel,
142                    OfflineChartRenderer renderer) {
143                // Store the intermediate result, but do not actively repaint
144                // as this could trigger another RE_RENDERING_PENDING if i.e.
145                // the buffer-image-size of the pending renderer differs from
146                // the current buffer-image-size.
147                panel.currentChartBuffer = renderer.buffer;
148                panel.currentChartRenderingInfo = renderer.info;
149                // Immediately start rendering again to update the chart to the
150                // latest requested state.
151                panel.pendingOfflineRenderer.execute();
152                panel.pendingOfflineRenderer = null;
153                return RENDERING;
154            }
155        };
156
157        /**
158         * Render the content offline.
159         *
160         * @param panel  the panel.
161         * @param renderer  the renderer.
162         * @return The state.
163         */
164        protected abstract State renderOffline(
165                final OfflineRenderingChartPanel panel,
166                final OfflineChartRenderer renderer);
167
168        /**
169         * Called when rendering is done.
170         *
171         * @param panel  the panel.
172         * @param renderer  the renderer.
173         * @return The state.
174         */
175        protected abstract State offlineRenderingDone(
176                final OfflineRenderingChartPanel panel,
177                final OfflineChartRenderer renderer);
178    }
179
180    /** A buffer for the rendered chart. */
181    private transient BufferedImage currentChartBuffer = null;
182    private transient ChartRenderingInfo currentChartRenderingInfo = null;
183
184    /** A pending rendering for the chart. */
185    private transient OfflineChartRenderer pendingOfflineRenderer = null;
186
187    /** The state. */
188    private State state = State.IDLE;
189

297
298    @Override
299    protected BufferedImage paintChartToBuffer(Graphics2D g2,
300            Dimension bufferSize, Dimension chartSize, Point2D anchor,
301            ChartRenderingInfo info) {
302        synchronized (state) {
303            if (this.currentChartBuffer == null) {
304                // Rendering the first time, prepare an empty buffer and
305                // start rendering, no need for an additional state
306                this.currentChartBuffer = createChartBuffer(g2, bufferSize);
307                clearChartBuffer(currentChartBuffer);
308                setRefreshBuffer(true);
309            } else if ((this.currentChartBuffer.getWidth() != bufferSize.width)
310                    || (this.currentChartBuffer
311                            .getHeight() != bufferSize.height)) {
312                setRefreshBuffer(true);
313            }
314
315            // do we need to redraw the buffer?
316            if (getRefreshBuffer()) {
317                setRefreshBuffer(false); // clear the flag
318
319                // Rendering is done offline, hence it requires a fresh buffer
320                // and rendering info
321                BufferedImage rendererBuffer = createChartBuffer(g2,
322                        bufferSize);
323                ChartRenderingInfo rendererInfo = info;
324                if (rendererInfo != null) {
325                    // As the chart will be re-rendered, the current chart
326                    // entities cannot be trusted
327                    final EntityCollection entityCollection = 
328                            rendererInfo.getEntityCollection();
329                    if (entityCollection != null) {
330                        entityCollection.clear();
331                    }
332
333                    // Offline rendering requires its own instance of
334                    // ChartRenderingInfo, using clone if possible
335                    try {
336                        rendererInfo = rendererInfo.clone();
337                    } catch (CloneNotSupportedException e) {
338                        // Not expected
339                        e.printStackTrace();
340                        rendererInfo = new ChartRenderingInfo();
341                    }
342                }
343
344                OfflineChartRenderer offlineRenderer = new OfflineChartRenderer(
345                        getChart(), rendererBuffer, chartSize, anchor,
346                        rendererInfo);
347                state = state.renderOffline(this, offlineRenderer);
348            }
349
350            // Copy the rendered ChartRenderingInfo into the passed info
351            // argument and mark that we have done so.
352            copyChartRenderingInfo(this.currentChartRenderingInfo, info);
353            this.currentChartRenderingInfo = info;
354
355            return this.currentChartBuffer;
356        }
357    }
358
359    private class OfflineChartRenderer extends SwingWorker<Object, Object> {
360        private final JFreeChart chart;
361        private final BufferedImage buffer;
362        private final Dimension chartSize;
363        private final Point2D anchor;
364        private final ChartRenderingInfo info;
365
366        public OfflineChartRenderer(JFreeChart chart, BufferedImage image,
367                Dimension chartSize, Point2D anchor, ChartRenderingInfo info) {
368            this.chart = chart;
369            this.buffer = image;
370            this.chartSize = chartSize;
371            this.anchor = anchor;
372            this.info = info;
373        }
374
375        @Override
376        protected Object doInBackground() throws Exception {
377            clearChartBuffer(buffer);
378
379            Graphics2D bufferG2 = buffer.createGraphics();
380            if ((this.buffer.getWidth() != this.chartSize.width)
381                    || (this.buffer.getHeight() != this.chartSize.height)) {
382                // Scale the chart to fit the buffer
383                bufferG2.scale(
384                        this.buffer.getWidth() / this.chartSize.getWidth(),
385                        this.buffer.getHeight() / this.chartSize.getHeight());
386            }
387            Rectangle chartArea = new Rectangle(this.chartSize);
388
389            this.chart.draw(bufferG2, chartArea, this.anchor, this.info);
390            bufferG2.dispose();
391
392            // Return type is not used
393            return null;
394        }
395
396        @Override
397        protected void done() {
398            synchronized (state) {
399                state = state.offlineRenderingDone(
400                        OfflineRenderingChartPanel.this, this);
401            }
402        }
403    }
404
405    @Override
406    public void setCursor(Cursor cursor) {
407        super.setCursor(cursor);
408
409        // Buggy mouse cursor: setting both behaves as expected
410        Container root = getTopLevelAncestor();
411        if (null != root) {
412            root.setCursor(cursor);
413        }
414    }
415
416    private static void copyChartRenderingInfo(ChartRenderingInfo source,
417            ChartRenderingInfo target) {
418        if (source == null || target == null || source == target) {
419            // Nothing to do
420            return;
421        }
422        target.clear();
423        target.setChartArea(source.getChartArea());
424        target.setEntityCollection(source.getEntityCollection());
425        copyPlotRenderingInfo(source.getPlotInfo(), target.getPlotInfo());
426    }
427
428    private static void copyPlotRenderingInfo(PlotRenderingInfo source,
429            PlotRenderingInfo target) {
430        target.setDataArea(source.getDataArea());
431        target.setPlotArea(source.getPlotArea());
432        for (int i = 0; i < source.getSubplotCount(); i++) {
433            PlotRenderingInfo subSource = source.getSubplotInfo(i);
434            PlotRenderingInfo subTarget = new PlotRenderingInfo(
435                    target.getOwner());
436            copyPlotRenderingInfo(subSource, subTarget);
437            target.addSubplotInfo(subTarget);
438        }
439    }
440
441    private static BufferedImage createChartBuffer(Graphics2D g2,
442            Dimension bufferSize) {
443        GraphicsConfiguration gc = g2.getDeviceConfiguration();
444        return gc.createCompatibleImage(bufferSize.width, bufferSize.height,
445                Transparency.TRANSLUCENT);
446    }
447
448    private static void clearChartBuffer(BufferedImage buffer) {
449        Graphics2D bufferG2 = buffer.createGraphics();
450        // make the background of the buffer clear and transparent
451        bufferG2.setComposite(AlphaComposite.getInstance(AlphaComposite.CLEAR, 0.0f));
452        bufferG2.fill(new Rectangle(buffer.getWidth(), buffer.getHeight()));
453        bufferG2.dispose();
454    }
455}
